description: This file defines the CustomReportUtils class with static methods for generating report queries, charts, and handling date-based search conditions within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: CustomReportUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for custom report query generation, chart creation, date handling, and entity type determination in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getCustomReportsQuery
methods.description: Generates SQL query for a specific report, optionally with filters, and determines if charts should be shown based on grouping.

methods.name: getReportChart
methods.description: Creates a chart (bar or pie) for a report based on report ID and chart type.

methods.name: IsDateField
methods.description: Checks if a report column is of date type based on its details.

methods.name: getAdvanceSearchCondition
methods.description: Builds advanced search conditions for date fields based on criteria like year, month, quarter, or none.

methods.name: getXAxisDateFieldValue
methods.description: Returns a formatted label for a date value based on the specified criteria (year, month, quarter, none).

methods.name: getEntityTypeFromName
methods.description: Determines the entity type (module name) from an entity name by querying entity tables.
